block_1_metadata.author: CreativeWorkzStudio LLC / ProfessorSeanEX
block_1_metadata.role: Typography and TrueType Font Rendering Subsystem Manifest
what_it_enables: High-fantasy typography with proportional responsive scaling
TrueType font rasterization with Xft and custom metrics caching
Zero-heap glyph metrics caching with pre-rendered advance tables
Graceful fallback to ASCII bitmap font in headless environments
invariants: Zero dynamic heap allocation during font metric queries (ALLOC_ZERO_HEAP)
Strict aspect ratio preservation: fonts scale proportionally with letterbox
Graceful fallback: plain ASCII 8x16 bitmap font in headless or Xft failure
Font files strictly located within game/assets/fonts/ directory

tripwires.condition: glyph metrics fit within pre-rendered static advance table
tripwires.action: Clamp glyph dimensions to max cell bounds
